title: Tileset
description: Definition of a tileset and its semantic tiles for the Game Boy RPG level editor.

id.description: Unique identifier for the tileset (e.g. forest, exterior, interior)

gb_tileset_kind.description: C enum constant for WorldTilesetKind (e.g. WORLD_TILESET_FOREST, WORLD_TILESET_EXTERIOR, WORLD_TILESET_INTERIOR)

tiles.description: List of tile definitions available in this tileset

id.description: Semantic tile ID within the tileset (e.g. floor, tree, building)

gb_constant.description: C enum constant for TileType (e.g. TILE_FLOOR, TILE_WALL, TILE_BUILDING, TILE_STUMP_TL)

walkable.description: Whether entities can walk over this tile

color.description: Hex color code for editor rendering

ascii.description: ASCII representation character (legacy display fallback; the ROM glyph comes from 'glyph' below)

glyph.description: Mandatory semantic glyph for this tile (e.g. T tree canopy, t trunk, s stump, O chest, R rock, ',' tufted ground). Drives the ROM text layer, the editor, and palette selection. See docs/glyphs.md for the registry. When absent, tools derive '.', '#', '>', '*' from walkable/category/exit.
